content:
{
  "findings": [
    {
      "title": "Inconsistent total sample size between synopsis and statistical plan",
      "quote": "Approximately 137 adult patients (53 in Group 1 and 84 in Group 2) are expected to be enrolled.",
      "page": 21,
      "section": "Synopsis - Population",
      "category": "consistency",
      "severity": "critical",
      "explanation": "The synopsis states a total of 137 patients, but the statistical plan later states 'the total sample sizes will be 53 patients for Group 1, and 84 patients for Group 2, for a total of 164 patients.' This is a direct numerical inconsistency that could affect trial planning and regulatory review.",
      "fix": "Correct the total sample size in the synopsis to 164 (or align the statistical plan with 137 if that is intended)."
    },
    {
      "title": "Primary endpoint definition inconsistent between synopsis and statistical plan",
      "quote": "The primary efficacy endpoint for this study is the ORR as determined by central review.",
      "page": 22,
      "section": "Synopsis - Endpoints",
      "category": "consistency",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The synopsis primary endpoint says ORR by central review, but the statistical plan states 'The primary endpoint for efficacy analyses is the ORR as determined by RECIST version 1.1 for visceral lesions or by modified WHO criteria for skin lesions or by the composite response criteria...' and also mentions central review. The criteria differ (RECIST vs modified WHO vs composite) and need to be reconciled.",
      "fix": "Clarify in both sections that the primary endpoint is ORR by central review using the specified criteria (RECIST 1.1, modified WHO, or composite) and ensure consistency."
    },
    {
      "title": "Secondary objectives list is incomplete in body",
      "quote": "The secondary objectives for both Group 1 and Group 2 are to: investigator review, and overall survival (OS)",
      "page": 31,
      "section": "2.2 Secondary Objectives",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The sentence is truncated and missing the full list of secondary objectives (e.g., duration of response, PFS, CR rate, safety, PK, immunogenicity). The synopsis lists these, but the body text is incomplete.",
      "fix": "Complete the secondary objectives list in Section 2.2 to match the synopsis."
    },
    {
      "title": "Trial schema missing",
      "quote": "Study Design This is a phase 2, non-randomized, 2-group, multi-center study",
      "page": 21,
      "section": "Synopsis - Study Design",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The protocol lacks a trial schema figure (M11 1.2), which is essential for understanding the study flow. The text describes the design but no visual schema is provided.",
      "fix": "Add a trial schema figure showing screening, treatment cycles, and follow-up periods."
    },
    {
      "title": "Contraception requirements not specified",
      "quote": "pregnancy test for women of childbearing potential",
      "page": 22,
      "section": "Synopsis - Procedures and Assessments",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The protocol mentions pregnancy tests but does not specify contraception requirements for patients, which is a critical safety and regulatory requirement for a study of an investigational drug.",
      "fix": "Add a section on contraception requirements, including methods and duration for both males and females."
    },
    {
      "title": "Trial stopping rules not described",
      "quote": "A patient will receive treatment until the 93-week treatment period is complete, or until disease progression (PD), unacceptable toxicity, withdrawal of consent, or confirmed CR.",
      "page": 21,
      "section": "Synopsis - Study Design",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The protocol describes individual patient stopping criteria but lacks trial-level stopping rules (e.g., for safety or futility). This is a required section (M11 4.3).",
      "fix": "Add a section on trial stopping rules, including criteria for early termination of the trial."
    },
    {
      "title": "Access to trial intervention after end of trial not described",
      "quote": "After the EOS visit, patients with PD should be followed for survival status until death, loss to follow up, or study termination by the sponsor.",
      "page": 21,
      "section": "Synopsis - Study Design",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The protocol does not describe whether patients will have access to cemiplimab after the trial ends (e.g., through an extension study or compassionate use). This is a required section (M11 4.5).",
      "fix": "Add a section describing post-trial access to the investigational intervention."
    },
    {
      "title": "Interim analysis description is vague",
      "quote": "An interim analysis for Group 1 will be performed at the time of the planned efficacy analysis for Group 2.",
      "page": 23,
      "section": "Synopsis - Statistical Plan",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "minor",
      "explanation": "The interim analysis is mentioned but not detailed (e.g., what will be evaluated, whether it is for futility or efficacy, and any stopping guidelines). This could lead to ambiguity in execution.",
      "fix": "Provide a detailed description of the interim analysis, including objectives, timing, and decision rules."
    }
  ]
}
